title: Mandar language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sulawesi, Indonesia
extract: Mandar is an Austronesian language spoken by the Mandar people living in West Sulawesi, Indonesia—particularly in the coastal regencies of Majene and Polewali Mandar. It is written in the Lontara script.
